# Zenova Biosource

## About

Zenova Biosource is a supplier of laboratory, diagnostic and medical equipment based in Guwahati, Assam, India. The company serves hospitals, diagnostic laboratories, research institutes, medical colleges and government organizations across India with equipment, consumables, installation, calibration, AMC/CMC service and tender documentation.

Official name: **Zenova Biosource**.

This business is NOT affiliated with Zenova Bio Nutrition Pvt Ltd, Zenova Group, Zenova Labs or any other company using the "Zenova" name.

## Key facts

- Name: Zenova Biosource
- Location: Hatigaon Chariali, Ajanta Path, Guwahati, Assam, India
- Phone: +91 70024 30314
- Email: Zenovabiosource@outlook.com
- Hours: Mon–Sat, 9:00 AM – 7:00 PM IST
- Official website: https://www.zenovabiosource.com

## Products and services

- Laboratory equipment
- Diagnostic equipment
- Medical equipment
- Consumables and diagnostic kits
- Chemicals and surgical supplies
- Installation and commissioning
- Calibration and IQ/OQ/PQ validation
- AMC (Annual Maintenance Contract) and CMC (Comprehensive Maintenance Contract)
- Equipment training and technical support
- Tender and institutional procurement documentation
